question.problem:
Suppose $a=[4,\,3,\,1]^{T},$ and $b=[5,\,3,\,4]^{T},$ and $p=4.$ Find the Minkowski distance between $a$ and $b.$

Rounded to three decimal places, ${d}_{p}(a,b)≈$
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the Minkowski distance is defined as

$$
{d}_{p}(a,b)=‖a-b{‖}_{p}
$$

where for an $N$-dimensional vector $v,$

$$
‖v{‖}_{p}={({\sum }_{i=1}^{N}|{v}_{i}{|}^{p})}^{1/p}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{4}(a,b) & =‖a-b{‖}_{4} \\  & ={‖[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]‖}_{4} \\  & ={(|4-5{|}^{4}+|3-3{|}^{4}+|1-4{|}^{4})}^{1/4} \\  & ={82}^{1/4} \\  & ≈3.009.\end{aligned}
$$
